## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。
body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

title.zh-TW: `gh pr checkout` 支援工作樹，切換 PR 不必動既有檔案
title.en: `gh pr checkout` adds `--worktree` to check out PRs into parallel copies

body.zh-TW: 正寫程式寫到一半，同事突然請你幫忙測試別人的 PR（pull request，請求將程式碼合併進專案的提案）。⟦像在圖書館查資料時直接影印一份副本帶到另一張桌子讀，原桌上攤開的筆記完全不用收拾。⟧這正是輸入 `gh pr checkout 123 --worktree` 的時刻。加上 `--worktree` 旗標後，系統會替該 PR 建立獨立的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。你能在新資料夾查看與測試變更，目前的檔案與分支留在原地，不必先把未完成的修改暫存收起。
body.en: While coding mid-task, a teammate asks you to test someone's PR (pull request). ⟦It is like photocopying a reference book in a library to read at another table without clearing your existing desk notes.⟧ That is the moment to run `gh pr checkout 123 --worktree`. Passing the `--worktree` flag creates an independent worktree, Git's feature for parallel working copies. You can inspect and test the changes in a separate folder while your current branch and files stay undisturbed.

items.original: Add --worktree flag to gh pr checkout by @tidy-dev in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13946

title.zh-TW: issue 搜尋加入 `--search-type`，支援語意與混合查詢
title.en: `gh search issues` adds `--search-type` for semantic and hybrid search

body.zh-TW: 在專案裡搜尋 issue（議題，追蹤問題與建議的討論清單）時，以前只能比對一模一樣的關鍵字。⟦像找歌時忘記歌名，哼出大概的旋律能按感覺找；若還記得一小段歌詞，便把歌詞片段和旋律一起交給找歌的人。⟧`gh search issues` 現在新增了 `--search-type` 旗標，支援語意搜尋與混合搜尋兩種模式。當你記不清確切的錯誤文字時，輸入概念描述並加上 `--search-type semantic`，便能依背後涵義找出相近的討論；加上 `--search-type hybrid` 則會同時比對關鍵字與語意。
body.en: When searching for issues in a repository, you used to rely strictly on exact keyword matches. ⟦It is like finding a song from a rough hummed melody, then giving the song finder both that melody and a remembered lyric fragment when you have one.⟧ `gh search issues` now introduces the `--search-type` flag, supporting both semantic and hybrid search modes. If you cannot remember the exact error text, pass `--search-type semantic` with a natural concept description to find relevant issues by meaning; using `--search-type hybrid` combines traditional keyword matching with semantic understanding.

title.zh-TW: 呼叫擴充套件自動帶入 `GH_EXTENSION=1`，身分識別更明確
title.en: `gh` sets `GH_EXTENSION=1` when executing extensions

body.zh-TW: 撰寫或執行 GitHub CLI 擴充套件（extension，為 gh 新增自訂指令的附加工具）時，程式往往需要知道自己是怎麼被啟動的。⟦像員工佩戴公司發放的識別證進場，保全一眼就能確認他是從內部系統派來的，而不是自行闖入的外部訪客。⟧`gh` 現在在叫用任何擴充套件時，都會在環境變數（開程式之前預先塞給它的隱藏開關，一般使用者看不到）自動帶上 `GH_EXTENSION=1`。這讓擴充套件能藉由檢查該變數，確認自己正在被 `gh` 呼叫，並據此調整輸出格式或執行流程。
body.en: When writing or running a GitHub CLI extension (an add-on tool that introduces custom commands to gh), the program often needs to know how it was started. ⟦It is like an employee wearing a company badge into the building so security immediately recognizes they were dispatched by the internal system rather than entering unannounced.⟧ When `gh` invokes any extension, it now automatically sets the environment variable `GH_EXTENSION=1`. Extensions can check this variable to confirm they are running under `gh` and adjust their output formatting or behavior accordingly.

items.original: Set GH_EXTENSION=1 when gh invokes an extension by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14072

title.zh-TW: 修正 `RESTWithNext` 錯誤型態，恢復 `gh status` 與 attestation 重試
title.en: Fixed `RESTWithNext` error type to restore `gh status` and attestation retries

body.zh-TW: 查詢 `gh status` 時若遇到可重試的失敗，錯誤型態 `RESTWithNext` 的判斷曾讓重試失效。現在已修正，`gh status` 和 attestation（證明軟體產物來源與建置過程的數位簽署證明）都能重新嘗試，不會在第一次失敗後停住。⟦這像送件窗口發現回條有誤時，不再直接把整份文件退回，而是讓它回到處理隊伍再送一次。⟧
body.en: When `gh status` hits a retryable failure, the `RESTWithNext` error-type handling had prevented retries. That is fixed: both `gh status` and attestations (digital signatures that verify a software artifact's origin and build process) can retry again. ⟦It is like a filing desk returning a form with a faulty receipt to the processing queue instead of rejecting the whole submission.⟧

items.original: Fix `RESTWithNext` error type, repairing `gh status` and attestation retries by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13988

title.zh-TW: `gh release create` 解析權限範圍時會去除空白
title.en: `gh release create` trims whitespace while parsing permission scopes

body.zh-TW: 建立 Release 時，`gh release create` 需要從 `X-Oauth-Scopes` 標頭讀取權限範圍。現在解析時會去掉前後多餘空白，避免空白被當成權限名稱的一部分。修正處理的是標頭文字的辨識，讓權限範圍能按原本的名稱解讀。空白不會參與辨識。⟦像讀取名單前先把姓名旁多出的空格擦掉，才不會把同一個人誤認成另一位。⟧
body.en: When creating a release, `gh release create` reads permission scopes from the `X-Oauth-Scopes` header. Its parser now strips extra surrounding whitespace so that whitespace is not treated as part of a scope name. ⟦It is like erasing stray spaces beside names on a roster so one person is not mistaken for another.⟧

items.original: Trim spaces when parsing X-Oauth-Scopes in `gh release create` by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14065

title.zh-TW: 修正非 TTY 環境的 `gh project item-add` 輸出
title.en: Fixed `gh project item-add` output outside a TTY

body.zh-TW: 把 `gh project item-add` 放進腳本或管線時，命令並未連接互動式終端機，也就是非 TTY（沒有互動式終端機螢幕的環境）。這種情況的輸出已修正，讓命令在非互動環境也能正確輸出。這是自動化流程使用命令時會遇到的輸出修正。腳本可直接使用。⟦這如同寄件單不經服務台螢幕，而是直接進入自動分揀線時，仍會印出供機器讀取的正確標籤。⟧
body.en: When `gh project item-add` runs in a script or pipeline, it has no interactive terminal, meaning it is outside a TTY (a terminal screen that accepts interaction). Its output in that case is fixed, so the command emits the correct output in non-interactive environments. ⟦It is like a shipping form that skips the service-desk screen and enters an automated sorting line while still printing the correct machine-readable label.⟧

items.original: Fix project item-add output for non-TTY by @zwick in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14056

title.zh-TW: 七項 API 請求收攏至 `api.Client`，統一金鑰與發布通道
title.en: Seven API request flows routed through unified `api.Client`

body.zh-TW: 手邊的 GitHub CLI 指令照舊可用，不必因內部 API 連線架構重整而切換操作方式。⟦像一棟大樓原本各辦公室各自拉電話線對外聯絡，現在全面改由中央總機統籌轉接，線路更整齊且便於維護。⟧開發團隊將七項操作的 HTTP 請求全面收攏至統一的 `api.Client`（負責管理連線與驗證的共用用戶端模組）。涵蓋對象包含 deploy key、ssh key、gpg key 三類金鑰，以及 autolink 自動連結、extension 擴充套件、release 建立與 release 刪除。請求集中由共用用戶端發送後，程式碼結構更乾淨，連線行為也維持一致。
body.en: Your existing GitHub CLI commands remain the same despite an internal API architecture refactor. ⟦It is like a building replacing separate external phone lines in every office with a centralized switchboard, keeping wiring tidy and maintainable.⟧ The team routed HTTP requests for seven operations through the unified `api.Client` (the shared client module managing connections and authentication). This covers deploy keys, ssh keys, gpg keys, autolinks, extensions, release creation, and release deletions. Routing these calls through a single client keeps network logic clean and consistent across the codebase.

title.zh-TW: 垃圾 issue 分流併入 agentic 工作流程並恢復自動結案
title.en: Spam triage moved into the agentic workflow with automatic closure restored

body.zh-TW: 專案把垃圾 issue 的分流整合進 agentic issue-triage 工作流程，並恢復自動關閉垃圾 issue。用來執行分流的 Action 相容性也已修正。分類與結案因而放在同一條處理路徑上，並確保這條路徑能相容執行。⟦這好比把廣告信篩選器裝進既有的收信流程：辨識出垃圾信後直接歸檔，不必再交給另一個不相容的分揀機。⟧
body.en: The project folded spam-issue triage into the agentic issue-triage workflow and restored automatic closure of spam issues. Compatibility for the Action that runs triage is fixed too. ⟦It is like placing a junk-mail filter inside the existing mail flow: identified flyers go straight to filing instead of being handed to an incompatible second sorter.⟧

title.zh-TW: PR 審查須明確指定負責人
title.en: PR reviews now require explicit ownership

body.zh-TW: 送出 PR（pull request，請求將程式碼合併進專案的提案）後，審查工作現在要求明確指定負責人。每一份等待審查的變更都要知道由誰接手，責任不再停留在未指派的狀態。這項規則只聚焦於審查歸屬的明確性。每份 PR 的審查責任都有明確歸屬。不再模糊。⟦這如同在任務看板的待辦卡上明確貼上負責人名條，避免卡片一直停在待辦清單卻沒人認領。⟧
body.en: After a PR (pull request) is submitted, review work now requires an explicitly named owner. Every pending change should have a person responsible for taking it up. ⟦It is like attaching a specific owner's name tag to a task card on the board so work does not sit unassigned in the queue.⟧

items.original: Require explicit PR review ownership by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14028

title.zh-TW: Dependabot 分流改為每小時執行，依程式碼可達性判斷
title.en: Dependabot triage runs hourly and checks code reachability

body.zh-TW: Dependabot（自動檢查相依套件更新的機器人）分流現在每小時執行。它的留言變短，判斷流程也改得更省成本、更果斷，並加入真正的程式碼可達性檢查：確認程式碼路徑是否真的能走到漏洞。它不只看到相依套件的問題，也會檢查程式實際能否觸及該問題。不是只看清單上的名稱。⟦這不是只看建築圖上有一扇失修的門，而是沿著走道實際確認能不能走到那扇門。⟧
body.en: Dependabot (the bot that checks dependency updates) triage now runs every hour. Its comments are shorter, its decisions are cheaper and more decisive, and it now performs a real code-reachability check: whether a code path can actually reach a vulnerability. ⟦Rather than merely spotting a broken door on a building plan, it follows the corridor to see whether that door can really be reached.⟧

title.zh-TW: AI 代理須套用 PR 範本，並釐清測試章節填寫規範
title.en: AI agents instructed to use PR template and clarified testing section requirements

body.zh-TW: 協助專案開發的 AI 代理準備提交 PR（pull request，請求將程式碼合併進專案的提案）時，現在必須依 `AGENTS.md` 規定的 PR 範本填寫。相關指引也進一步釐清了測試章節的填寫範圍，明確指出哪些驗證細節應記錄在該欄位。⟦像填寫制式的交接報告單，表格在驗收欄明確註記該登記哪些檢查項目，避免漏記關鍵細節。⟧這讓代理提交變更時有統一的交件標準，協助審查者迅速確認測試狀況。
body.en: When an AI agent prepares to submit a PR (pull request), `AGENTS.md` now directs it to follow the standard pull request template. The guidelines also clarify what belongs in the PR template's testing section, defining which verification details must be recorded. ⟦It is like filling out a standardized handover report with clear instructions on which checklist items to log in the verification section.⟧ These updates give agents clear rules for submitting changes so reviewers can quickly assess test coverage.

title.zh-TW: 新增排程清理技術債技能，定期維護專案程式碼
title.en: Added scheduled tech debt burndown skill for periodic maintenance

body.zh-TW: 專案維護久了，程式庫常累積零星的待辦標記、過時設定或待整理的舊結構，平時卻抽不出完整時間手動整理。專案現在為 AI 代理新增了排程清理技術債技能（tech debt burndown skill，定期處理專案累積技術債務的專用指令技能）。在排程設定中啟用並排定觸發時間後，代理便會按固定週期自動檢視並清理這些技術債。⟦像在大樓日誌裡排定例行大掃除，定期把倉庫堆積的雜物與舊箱子清運出去，不讓零碎雜物越積越多。⟧透過將清債任務標準化與排程化，專案能持續維持程式碼的整潔度與健康度。
body.en: As a repository grows, it often accumulates lingering TODOs, outdated configurations, or disorganized code structures that developers rarely have dedicated time to clean up. The project now introduces a scheduled tech debt burndown skill for AI agents. Once configured with a schedule, the agent automatically triggers on a recurring interval to inspect the codebase and clean up technical debt. ⟦It is like putting a regular deep-cleaning schedule on the building calendar to clear out accumulated clutter from the storage room before it piles up.⟧ Standardizing and scheduling these cleanups helps teams keep the repository tidy and maintainable over time.

items.original: Add a scheduled tech debt burndown skill by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14095

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查技能更名為 `code-review`，簡化呼叫識別
title.en: Renamed cli-code-reviewer skill to code-review

body.zh-TW: 專案調整了程式碼審查技能的命名，將原本的 `cli-code-reviewer` 正式更名為更簡短的 `code-review`。這項變更讓技能名稱更直覺且符合日常用法，去除多餘的前綴詞後也更容易被指令系統與開發者辨識。⟦像把辦公室門口冗長的「內部文件審查員室」標示，更換成簡潔明瞭的「審查室」門牌。⟧這次更名僅調整技能識別名稱，不影響原有的審查功能與運作機制。
body.en: The repository renamed the `cli-code-reviewer` skill to the simpler and more concise `code-review`. Dropping the verbose prefix makes the skill name more intuitive and easier to recognize when invoking agent capabilities. ⟦It is like replacing a wordy "Internal Document Reviewer Room" sign on an office door with a clean, straightforward "Review Room" plaque.⟧ This update changes only the identifier, leaving the underlying review functionality unchanged.

items.original: Rename cli-code-reviewer skill to code-review by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14116

title.zh-TW: Linux APT 套件庫改採雙金鑰簽署
title.en: Linux APT repository now uses dual-key signing

body.zh-TW: Linux 系統的 APT 套件庫現在同時以兩把金鑰進行簽署。在 CI（持續整合，自動執行檢查的流程）中，團隊先前曾短暫加入驗證 Linux 套件庫簽署金鑰的臨時步驟，在確認簽署狀態正常後隨即撤回該臨時步驟。整項改動僅涉及雙金鑰簽署與臨時驗證步驟的清理。⟦像在同一份公文上同時蓋上兩枚印章以供雙重辨識，期間查驗處短暫增設了核印櫃檯，確認無誤後隨即撤除。⟧
body.en: The Linux APT repository is now signed with both keys simultaneously. In CI (continuous integration, an automated checking process), the team briefly added a temporary step to verify the repository signing keys, then promptly reverted that check after confirming the setup. The update focuses strictly on the dual-key signing and cleaning up the temporary verification step. ⟦It is like stamping an official document with two separate seals for dual verification, while an inspection checkpoint is briefly set up to verify the stamps before being removed.⟧

title.zh-TW: 測試不再讀取本機認證與 Git 設定
title.en: Tests no longer read local authentication or Git configuration

body.zh-TW: 你在自己的電腦上跑測試時，登入認證與 Git 設定本來就可能和其他人的不同，讓測試帶著個人環境的影子。這次調整把測試和本機的認證、Git 設定隔開，使測試執行時不再讀取這兩類本機資料。⟦像把實驗樣本放到專用的乾淨工作台上，只讓實驗指定的材料進場，不把研究員口袋裡的東西混進結果。⟧重點不是換掉你的認證或 Git 設定，而是讓測試不依賴它們。
body.en: When you run tests on your own machine, its authentication and Git configuration can differ from someone else's and leak personal-environment details into the run. This change isolates tests from both kinds of local data, so they no longer read local authentication or Git configuration. ⟦It is like placing samples on a dedicated clean workbench, allowing in only the materials for the experiment rather than anything in the researcher's pockets.⟧ Your credentials and Git settings are not being replaced; the tests simply no longer depend on them.

items.original: Isolate tests from local machine's auth and git configuration by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14128

title.zh-TW: 部署驗證接受預發布標籤
title.en: Deployment validation accepts pre-release tags

body.zh-TW: 部署流程驗證版本標籤時，現在接受預發布（pre-release，正式發布前使用的版本標籤）標籤。預發布標籤用來標示正式發布之前的版本；部署驗證會把這一類標籤視為可接受的輸入。⟦像活動入口除了正式票券，也核驗試營運場次的票券，兩種票都能通過入口。⟧這項調整只改部署驗證對標籤的接受條件，讓使用預發布標籤的部署流程不必在驗證處被擋下。
body.en: When a deployment flow validates a version tag, it now accepts a pre-release tag, a tag for a version before formal release. Deployment validation therefore treats that tag type as acceptable input. ⟦It is like an event entrance validating tickets for a trial-run session as well as tickets for the formal opening, letting both through the gate.⟧ The change is limited to which tags deployment validation accepts, so a deployment using a pre-release tag is not stopped at that check.

items.original: Accept pre-release tags in deployment validation by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14193

title.zh-TW: 以 `reflect.Pointer` 取代已淘汰的 `reflect.Ptr`
title.en: Replaced deprecated `reflect.Ptr` with `reflect.Pointer`

body.zh-TW: 程式碼把已淘汰的 `reflect.Ptr` 改為 `reflect.Pointer`，完成一次 API（應用程式介面，程式用來呼叫功能的固定方式）替換。這不是新增另一種呼叫方式，而是將原先使用的過時名稱換成目前的名稱。⟦像把老舊規格的轉接頭換成現行規格，插在原本位置仍是為了完成同一段連接。⟧若你正在閱讀相關程式碼，看到 `reflect.Pointer` 就是在辨認這項替換後使用的 API。
body.en: Code now replaces deprecated `reflect.Ptr` with `reflect.Pointer`, completing an API (application programming interface, a fixed way for programs to call a capability) substitution. This does not add a second way to make the call; it changes the outdated name that the code used to the current one. ⟦It is like swapping an old-standard adapter for one that meets the current standard while using the same connection point.⟧ When reading the relevant code, `reflect.Pointer` is the API used after this replacement.

items.original: Use reflect.Pointer instead of deprecated reflect.Ptr by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14098

title.zh-TW: 不需要清理時不再要求功能偵測註解
title.en: Feature detection no longer requests cleanup comments when unneeded

body.zh-TW: 功能偵測（feature detection，先確認功能是否可用的做法）不需要清理時，現在不再要求清理註解。這條規則把是否需要清理當成是否提出註解要求的界線：有清理需要的地方可留下相應註解，沒有清理需要的地方則不因同一件事再被要求補註。⟦像工作單只在確有後續收尾工作時附上提醒；沒有待收尾的項目，就不多附一張提醒單。⟧改動的重點是刪除不必要的要求，讓註解要求和實際清理需要對齊。
body.en: When feature detection (checking whether a capability is available) needs no cleanup, it no longer requests a cleanup comment. Whether cleanup is needed now forms the boundary for asking for that comment: a corresponding comment can be left where cleanup is needed, but an item needing none is not asked for one. ⟦It is like attaching a reminder to a work order only when follow-up work really remains; an item with nothing to finish gets no extra reminder slip.⟧ The change removes an unneeded request so that the request for a comment matches the actual need for cleanup.

items.original: Don't ask for feature detection cleanup comments when not needed by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14139

title.zh-TW: 建置工具與相依套件升級，Dependabot 新增 aw-actions 群組

Go moved through 1.26.6 to 1.26.7, CI's golangci-lint reached v2.12.2, gh-aw workflows reached v0.85.4, and gh-aw-actions reached v0.87.1 with agentic workflows recompiled. ⟦It is like replacing parts from a maintenance list while updating the automatic replenishment rule and already assembled work orders too.⟧

title.zh-TW: 用名稱改 Project 項目，清單欄位也看得到名字
title.en: Edit Project items by name and see named fields in lists

body.zh-TW: 你在 GitHub Project（把工作拆成卡片和欄位的管理看板）裡找待辦事項，不必先翻出那串難記的 ID 了。`gh project item-edit` 現在能依名稱找到項目；像整理「修登入頁」這張卡時，可直接用它的名字指定對象。`gh project item-list` 也能把具名欄位列出來，清單不再只像一排沒有標籤的抽屜。搜尋某個儲存庫時，`gh search --repo` 會提示 `OWNER/REPO` 格式，文件也把依名稱編輯列為主要做法。
body.en: When you are looking for a task in a GitHub Project, you no longer have to dig up its hard-to-remember ID first. `gh project item-edit` can now resolve an item by name, so you can target a card such as “Fix login page” by its name. `gh project item-list` can show named field columns too, rather than a row of unlabeled drawers. `gh search --repo` now hints at the `OWNER/REPO` format, and the docs present name-based editing as the main Project flow.

title.zh-TW: `gh skill` 接上 Grok，代理清單換成 Devin
title.en: `gh skill` adds Grok and swaps Windsurf for Devin

body.zh-TW: 想讓 AI 代理幫忙檢視程式碼時，`gh skill` 的選項更新了。它新增 Grok 的 skill host 支援，也把代理清單中的 Windsurf 換成 Devin；選擇畫面過長的標籤換行問題一併修好。專案還加入 code review agent skill，也就是給代理做程式碼審查用的操作說明。像替工具箱添了新轉接頭，現在能接 Grok；舊的 Windsurf 插槽則改標 Devin，拿取時不會再被斷行的標籤絆住。
body.en: If you use AI agents to review code, `gh skill` has refreshed its choices. It adds support for Grok as a skill host and replaces Windsurf with Devin in its agent list; labels that wrapped awkwardly in the picker have also been fixed. The project now includes a code-review agent skill: instructions for an agent doing code review. Think of a toolbox gaining a new adapter for Grok while the old Windsurf slot is relabeled Devin, with no wrapped label getting in the way.

title.zh-TW: 驗證缺根憑證不再卡死，macOS 解鎖多等一分鐘
title.en: Missing verifier roots no longer halt setup; macOS keyring access gets a minute

body.zh-TW: 開啟 GitHub CLI 時，驗證器需要的 trusted root（用來確認信任鏈起點的根憑證）若缺失，初始化失敗現在會被妥善處理，不會讓這一步變成死結。macOS 的 keyring（存放登入金鑰的地方）若跳出互動式解鎖提示，等待時間也從 3 秒延到 60 秒。這版還補上 macOS keyring 的安全文件。像進大樓時保全發現名冊少一頁，會改走可處理的流程；而你正翻包找門禁卡，櫃台願意多等一分鐘。
body.en: When GitHub CLI starts, verifier initialization can fail because a trusted root—the root certificate at the start of a chain of trust—is missing. That failure is now handled gracefully instead of becoming a dead end. On macOS, an interactive keyring access prompt now gets 60 seconds rather than 3 seconds. This release also adds security documentation for the macOS keyring. It is like a guard finding a page missing from a visitor list and following a workable procedure, while the desk gives you a full minute to find your access card.

title.zh-TW: 專案自動流程整理：分流 issue、部署與依賴更新
title.en: Project automation tidied: issue triage, deployment, and dependency updates

body.zh-TW: 這張卡講的是 gh 專案自己的後勤，不是你今天要輸入的新指令。團隊新增 pull request 範本、用代理分流 issue 的 workflow，也新增 Dependabot 的分流流程；issue 分流 workflow 改用 Actions token 做 Copilot 推論，並更新到 gh-aw v0.83.1。部署 workflow 加強，網站部署用的 `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` 改由 gh-cli-site-deployer App 取代。CodeQL 的 Dependabot 更新會分組處理，Go 與多個函式庫、Actions 也陸續升版；無效的 CODEOWNERS 規則與程式、文件、註解的錯字一併清掉。像倉庫後場重新排班：分貨、交接、補貨都各自有路走，前台的 CLI 使用方式沒有因此多一道手續。
body.en: This card is about the gh project's own backstage work, not a new command for you to type today. The team adds a pull-request template, an agentic issue-triage workflow, and a Dependabot-triage workflow; the issue-triage workflow uses the Actions token for Copilot inference and is refreshed to gh-aw v0.83.1. The deployment workflow is hardened, and `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` is replaced by the gh-cli-site-deployer App. CodeQL Dependabot updates are grouped, while Go, libraries, and Actions receive updates; a dead CODEOWNERS rule and typos in code, docs, and comments are removed. It is like reorganizing a warehouse back room: sorting, handoffs, and restocking each get their own route, without adding a step to the CLI counter.

title.zh-TW: 免登入下載公開專案的發布檔
title.en: Download public releases without authentication

body.zh-TW: 你是不是常在沒有登入帳號的乾淨電腦上，只想快速下載某個公開專案的安裝檔，卻被登入提示卡住？以往即使你想抓取的軟體是放在完全公開的專案中，執行命令時，系統還是會硬性要求進行 authentication（驗證程序，確認使用者身分的程序）才能下載。現在這個不方便的門檻被移除了，只要是公開專案，任何人都可以免登入直接把發布檔抓下來。這就像走進免費開放的市立圖書館拿一份導覽手冊，以前警衛還會擋在門口硬要你掏出借書證來登記，現在只要是公開擺在架上的東西，你推開門就能直接拿走。當你在新主機上需要快速抓取公開安裝檔時，這正是你輸入 `gh release download` 的時刻，保證一路暢通。
body.en: Have you ever tried to quickly fetch a release installer from a public repository on a clean system, only to be blocked by login prompts? Previously, even when a tool was hosted in a completely public project, trying to grab it would trigger a mandatory authentication (verification process confirming your identity) flow. We have now removed this hurdle, allowing anonymous access to all public releases. It is like walking into a public library to grab a brochure: the guard used to stubbornly demand your library card just to take a free leaflet, but now you can just walk in and take it. When you need to fetch a public installer on a new machine, that is when to run `gh release download` and download it without any hassle.

title.zh-TW: 廣納更多 AI 代理工具，技能安裝更聽話
title.en: More AI agents supported and smarter skill installation

body.zh-TW: 你正在為 AI 代理工具配置新的擴充能力，卻因為指令一直彈出不必要的提問而感到心煩？這次更新擴大了支援，讓 `gh skill` 指令能自動偵測更多第三方的 coding agents（寫程式碼代理，能協助撰寫程式碼的 AI 助手），並完整支援 `antigravity-cli` 與 `antigravity2.0`。此外，通用技能的預設安裝路徑也更正為 `~/.agents/skills`；更棒的是，如果你已經指定了安裝目錄參數，系統就不會再彈出冗餘的 prompt（互動提示，指程式在終端機中要求使用者輸入或選擇的畫面），會直接遵守你的選擇。這就像買了一支萬用遙控器，它學會了最新電視的頻率，而且當你指著電視按開關時，它不會再跳出選單囉唆地問你要遙控哪台設備。當你想自訂路徑且不想被打擾，這正是你使用 `gh skill` 指令的時刻。
body.en: Are you setting up custom capabilities for your AI helper, only to be annoyed by redundant terminal questions? This update expands the reach of the `gh skill` command to detect more third-party coding agents (AI assistants that help you write code) and officially support `antigravity-cli` and `antigravity2.0`. Under the hood, universal skills are now correctly routed to `~/.agents/skills`. Best of all, if you specify the installation path directly, the system will honor it without prompting (asking questions via terminal menu dialogs). It is like using a universal remote that supports the latest TVs; when you point it at the screen and press power, it no longer pops up a menu asking which device you wish to control. When you want a silent, customized install, that is when to run `gh skill`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Codespace 轉發當機與 CI 狀態空白
title.en: Fixes for Codespace port forwarding crashes and blank CI summaries

body.zh-TW: 你是否遇過雲端開發環境突然崩潰，或是自動化檢查被取消後，狀態欄只顯示一片空白？這次修復專門為這些不穩定的角落提供保護。首先，處理 codespace port forwarding（連接埠轉發，將雲端開發機器的網路連接埠導引至本機的傳輸技術）時，背後因 concurrent map writes（併發寫入衝突，指多個處理程序同時修改同一份內部資料造成的當機錯誤）導致連線崩潰的問題已解決。此外，當 CI checks（自動化檢查）被全部取消時，摘要畫面的空白已被老實顯示的取消通知取代。這就像餐廳裡兩個服務生同時往同個格子上寫點單，紙張撕破導致系統當機的問題被修好了；而且如果整桌退單，看板也會清楚寫明「已取消」而非留下一塊讓人瞎猜的空白黑板。
body.en: Have you ever had your cloud development environment crash, or been left guessing when cancelled automation runs showed nothing at all? We have hardened these fragile areas. We resolved a crash where codespace port forwarding (connecting network ports of a remote container to your local machine) failed due to concurrent map writes (a data collision error when multiple processes modify the same memory table simultaneously). Additionally, if CI checks (automated checks) are cancelled, the summary screen now reports the status instead of displaying a blank void. It's like a restaurant fixing a glitch where two waiters writing on the same order ticket caused a system crash, and ensuring that if a table cancels, the kitchen screen displays "Cancelled" instead of an empty black board.

title.zh-TW: 資料庫識別碼升級與工作流安全性補強
title.en: Database ID upgrades and workflow security reinforcement

body.zh-TW: 當專案資料庫的識別碼數量日益膨脹，或是自動化工作流面臨被惡意修改的安全風險？為了解決底層的潛在危機，系統在多處細節做出了補強。首先，將 database IDs（資料庫識別碼，用來標示每筆資料唯一身分的數字代號）的資料型態升級為更大的 64 位元整數，防止隨著 GitHub 資料量成長而溢位。同時，將可重複使用的 triage workflows（工作流，特定事件觸發時自動執行的指令腳本）固定在特定的 commit SHA，防止工作流遭到篡改，並在說明中澄清了複製指令的行為。這就像將倉庫的舊鎖頭升級，把不夠大的抽屜換成超大保險櫃，並對自動門鎖裝上硬體鎖定，不管資料如何成長或外部如何變化，系統都能牢牢守護一切，不再因老舊漏洞而動搖。
body.en: Are you worried about database identifiers overflowing as records grow, or automated pipelines facing security threats from malicious changes? To address these underlying risks, we have reinforced several security and architectural details. The database IDs are now upgraded to 64-bit integers to prevent truncation on large data sets. Additionally, we pinned reusable triage workflows to a specific commit SHA to lock down their versions against unexpected alterations, and clarified command behavior in help files. It is like replacing shallow storage drawers with a giant vault and adding a physical lock to automated doors; the system stands secure and robust, unaffected by data growth or external tampering.

title.en: New commands to read repository files and directories directly

body.zh-TW: 你正在終端機前趕報告，突然需要快速確認專案裡某個設定檔的幾行內容，或是想看一下特定資料夾底下有哪些檔案？以往你可能得先用瀏覽器打開 GitHub 網站慢慢點，或是把整個專案下載到本機才能查看。這次新增了 `repo read-file` 與 `repo read-dir` 兩個新功能，讓你直接在終端機裡就能讀取專案檔案與資料夾內容。這就像在圖書館，你現在可以直接站在目錄櫃前查閱書名與特定章節，不用把整本書借回家慢慢翻。當你只想確認一下別人專案裡的 README（專案說明檔）寫了什麼，這正是你打 `gh repo read-file` 的時刻，不用花時間複製整個專案，就能直接在畫面上讀取內容。
body.en: Are you working in your terminal and need to quickly check the content of a configuration file in a repository, or see what files are in a directory? Previously, you had to open GitHub in a browser or clone the whole project locally. We've added two new features, `repo read-file` and `repo read-dir`, so you can inspect files and folders right from the command line. It's like standing at a library catalog card cabinet to check book titles or read specific chapters, without checking out the whole book. When you just want to check a remote project's instructions, that is when to run `gh repo read-file`, showing you the text instantly without cloning the project.

title.zh-TW: AI 技能管理更安全彈性
title.en: Safer and more flexible AI skill management

body.zh-TW: 你正在為 AI 助手安裝或升級新功能，卻擔心安裝到一半出錯，會把原本正常運作的工具搞壞？這次升級改良了技能安裝機制，在更新時會先在一個 temp dir（臨時資料夾）把檔案準備好，確認沒問題才進行 swap in-place（原地替換），避免升級中斷留下半殘的檔案。此外，如果你用 non-interactively（非互動模式，指程式自動執行不跳出確認提示的運行方式）進行安裝，系統也會自動列出所有可用技能，並支援自訂 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 指向特定的設定檔存放目錄。這就像裝修店面，以前工人在營業走道上敲打，停電就留下一地爛攤子；現在他們在後台工坊組裝好新櫃子，半夜一次完美換上。當你想把 AI 設定檔改存到自訂路徑，這正是你設定 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 的時刻。
body.en: Are you installing or upgrading new functions for your AI helper, but worried that a failure midway might break your working tools? The installation process is now much safer by staging updates in a temp dir (temporary directory) and executing a swap in-place (atomic replacement) only when ready, preventing broken files from failed upgrades. During automated non-interactively (non-interactive, running without user prompts) setups, the system now lists all available skills and lets you customize the directory. It is like renovating a shop: workers used to hammer in open aisles and leave a mess if the power failed; now they assemble cabinets in a back workshop and swap them overnight. When you want to store configs in a custom path, that is when to set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.

title.zh-TW: gh CLI 終端機直接開討論串
title.en: gh CLI can now drive GitHub Discussions from the terminal

body.zh-TW: gh CLI 現在能直接在命令列操作 GitHub Discussions（討論區功能，社群提問與閒聊的看板）了，這是預覽版（preview，功能還在測試、之後可能調整）。新增「gh discussion」指令組：list 列出討論串、view 看內容、create 開新討論、edit 編輯，另外「gh discussion comment」可以直接留言或回覆別人的討論。內建的 gh 技能（skill，讓 AI 代理知道怎麼用 gh 指令的說明書）也同步補上這批 discussion 指令和 Issues 2.0 的用法說明。像原本只能用網頁逛的社群留言板，現在終端機也能直接開窗留言。
body.en: gh CLI can now drive GitHub Discussions (a community Q&A and chat board) straight from the command line — this is a preview (the feature is still being tested and may change). The new `gh discussion` command set covers `list`, `view`, `create`, and `edit`, and `gh discussion comment` lets you post or reply to a discussion directly. The built-in `gh` skill (a skill is a manual that tells an AI agent how to use `gh` commands) has also been updated with these discussion commands and Issues 2.0 usage notes. It's like a community message board you used to have to browse on the web now getting its own window right in your terminal.

It's like swapping a sticky note crammed with to-dos for a board where you can categorize, split into smaller notes, and draw connecting lines — managing a big project's issues no longer means cramming everything onto one list.

body.en: The `gh skill` (a skill is a bundle of instructions that tells an AI agent how to do a task) command family got more usable. And skill files buried in nested subfolders, which used to go undetected, are now found too. It's like a warehouse toolbox finally getting an inventory list, one-click restocking, tools without labels no longer jamming the count, and gear buried deep in the cabinet finally turning up.

title.zh-TW: 身分驗證與 API 檢查更準了
title.en: Authentication and API checks get more accurate

body.zh-TW: 這批修的是幾個跟認證、API 檢查有關的準確度問題。以前 secrets（機密資訊，例如 API 金鑰）只能綁在使用者或 repository（儲存庫）上，現在也能讓 agent（代理，例如自動化機器人）以 application（應用程式身分）的名義使用 secrets。查詢 PR（pull request，程式碼合併請求）時，以前有個「只認編號」的優化捷徑會跳過 API 驗證，可能讓查詢結果不準，現在拿掉這個捷徑，改成每次都好好驗證。以前遇到 401（未授權）錯誤只丟出一個看不懂的錯誤，現在會直接印出「請跑 gh auth refresh」提醒你該重新驗證登入了。gh copilot 指令執行失敗時，以前只丟錯誤訊息，現在會提示你直接跑 copilot 指令排查。像 ATM 提款失敗時不再只顯示錯誤代碼，而是直接告訴你下一步該怎麼做。
body.en: This batch fixes a handful of accuracy issues around authentication and API checks. Secrets (sensitive values like API keys) used to be scoped only to a user or a repository; now an agent (an automated bot, for example) can also use secrets under an application identity. Looking up a PR (pull request) by number used to take a "number-only" shortcut that skipped API validation, which could return inaccurate results; that shortcut is gone, so every lookup is validated now. Hitting a 401 (unauthorized) error used to just print an unhelpful error; now it prints "run gh auth refresh" to tell you exactly what to do. When `gh copilot` fails to run, it now hints you to run the copilot command directly to troubleshoot, instead of just showing an error. It's like an ATM that no longer just flashes an error code when a withdrawal fails, but tells you directly what to do next.

title.zh-TW: 供應鏈安全再加固，發布版本鎖不可改
title.en: Supply-chain security tightens up; releases get locked

body.zh-TW: 這批是供應鏈安全（確保下載的軟體沒被竄改）的強化。gh release verify（驗證發布版本完整性的指令）現在會依 ref（版本標籤）長度自動判斷該用哪種 digest algorithm（雜湊演算法，驗證檔案有沒有被改過的方法），驗證更準確。CLI 建置流程把驗證用的 actions/attest-build-provenance 換成 actions/attest（GitHub 另一款官方認證動作）。專案的 GitHub Actions（自動化流程腳本）裡，first-party（GitHub 自己維護）的動作改用 SHA（固定版本雜湊值）釘死版本，不因對方改版悄悄變不同內容。文件也註記從 v2.93.0 起，GitHub Releases 會變 immutable（不可變更，發布後鎖死不能再改）。像貨物出廠前多蓋一層封條，用固定版號的檢驗員，貨才不會被中途調包。
body.en: This batch strengthens supply-chain security (making sure the software you download hasn't been tampered with). `gh release verify` (the command that checks a release's integrity) now derives the right digest algorithm (the hashing method used to verify content hasn't changed) from the length of the ref (version tag), making verification more accurate. The CLI's own build pipeline switched its verification action from `actions/attest-build-provenance` to `actions/attest` (another official GitHub-hosted attestation action). In the project's own GitHub Actions (automation scripts), first-party actions (ones GitHub itself maintains) are now pinned by SHA (a fixed version hash), so they can't silently change content if the upstream action gets updated. Docs also now note that starting with v2.93.0, GitHub Releases become immutable (locked after publishing — no more edits). It's like sealing a shipment before it leaves the factory and using an inspector who only checks a fixed batch number, so the goods can't be swapped mid-transit.

title.zh-TW: 擴充技能安裝與預覽更簡明，全面支援企業雲端資料存儲
title.en: Extensions install flat by name and support GHEC with data residency

body.zh-TW: 現在你在預覽自訂擴充技能時，可以直接帶上參數來允許讀取隱藏的資料夾；如果你的公司使用限制資料只能存在特定地區的企業雲（GHEC，GitHub 企業雲端版），系統也能正常連線支援。同時，安裝這些技能時，系統會直接用技能本身的名稱存檔，不再加上複雜的前綴命名空間，讓路徑更簡潔。就像你的手機安裝小工具，以前必須按照開發者名字分類塞在好幾層資料夾裡，現在安裝直接放在案頭，而且在資料必須存於特定地區時也能正常使用。
body.en: You can now preview and install custom extensions with more flexibility, and easily comply with corporate data residency policies. When previewing skills, you can pass a flag to allow access to hidden directories, and the system now fully supports GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC) with data residency hosts. Additionally, skills are now installed flatly by their name rather than namespaces, making file paths much cleaner. It's like installing widgets on your phone: instead of nesting them deep inside folders named after developers, they now sit directly on your home screen, and it supports corporate data-residency requirements.

title.zh-TW: 過濾日誌控制碼防禦終端機注入攻擊，新增擴充功能安全警告
title.en: Clean logs to prevent terminal injection and add security warnings to extensions

body.zh-TW: 現在當你在查看執行紀錄時，系統會先過濾掉可能隱藏的惡意控制碼，防止有心人士透過終端機注入攻擊（terminal injection）來控制你的畫面。同時，當你查閱擴充功能說明時，畫面會貼心顯示安全免責聲明，提醒你只安裝信任的工具。此外，自動部署設定檔（deployment.yml）中關於變數替換的寫法也修正了，避免自動化流程出錯。就像你在路邊看佈告欄，以前可能有人在海報下偷黏按鈕騙你按，現在不僅海報被防護玻璃罩住，佈告欄旁邊還立了警告標語提醒你小心詐騙。
body.en: You can now review logs and install third-party extensions with much better protection against malicious exploits. The CLI now filters unsafe escape codes when outputting logs to prevent terminal injection from manipulating your screen. Additionally, help pages for extensions now display a clear trust disclaimer, reminding you to only run extensions you trust. A syntax fix was also applied to variable interpolation in deployment workflows (deployment.yml) to keep automated processes stable. It's like looking at a public bulletin board: previously someone could hide sticky buttons under posters to trick you, but now the posters are behind safety glass and there's a warning sign reminding you to watch out for scams.

title.zh-TW: 忽略專案看板無權限錯誤，修復 Linux 自動補完與統計回報
title.en: Ignore project access errors and fix Linux autocompletion and telemetry metrics

body.zh-TW: 現在在 Debian 系統上使用 zsh（一種終端機 shell 軟體）時，自動補完功能可以正常運作了。同時，如果你在存取專案看板時遇到「資源無法存取」的錯誤，系統會自動忽略，不會再像以前那樣直接中斷崩潰。底層也升級了 Go 語言與多個終端介面套件，修復了統計回報率沒有正確更新的問題。就像你去圖書館借書，以前遇到沒權限的書櫃機器人會直接死機，而且查詢系統還經常打錯字、自動推薦按不出來；現在它會自動跳過不合適的書，找書的過程也更順暢。
body.en: You can now enjoy a smoother autocompletion experience and more stable CLI runs across different Linux environments. When running tab completions with zsh on Debian, autocomplete options now resolve correctly. In project management, accessing boards and hitting a "Resource not accessible" error will be gracefully ignored instead of crashing your session. Telemetry metrics also received a fix, ensuring the sample rate updates correctly. It's like visiting a library: previously, if you walked past a locked door, the guide robot would freeze completely, the lookup catalog had typos, and search suggestions didn't work. Now, it silently bypasses restricted sections, and looking up books is completely frictionless.

title.zh-TW: 技能可裝進更多 AI 工具，搜尋與發布更不容易搞錯
title.en: Skills install into more AI tools, with safer discovery and publishing

body.zh-TW: 你可以用 `gh skills install` 把同一個技能裝進多個 agent host（承載 AI 代理工具的應用程式），不必逐一手動複製。安裝時可選擇允許隱藏資料夾，搜尋也會認得巢狀的 `skills/` 資料夾；若發現某技能曾重新發布，會提供安裝上游版本的選項。預覽會依安裝名稱正確比對，避免看錯技能。`gh` 與 `gh-skill` 的 agent skills 文件也已補上。`skills publish --fix` 也終於只修正問題、不會意外發布，而介面刪除了誤導文字。像替一把萬用鑰匙配多扇門：門更多、標籤更準，修鎖時也不會順手把門打開。
body.en: You can now use `gh skills install` to put one skill into multiple agent hosts, the apps that run AI agents, without copying it by hand to each one. Installation can allow hidden directories, and discovery recognizes nested `skills/` directories. When a skill has been republished, the CLI can offer its upstream version for installation. Preview matches by install name, so you see the right skill. Documentation now includes `gh` and `gh-skill` agent skills. `skills publish --fix` now fixes issues without accidentally publishing, and misleading interface text has been removed. It is like fitting one master key to more doors: there are more doors, clearer labels, and fixing a lock does not also open it.

title.zh-TW: 新增遙測控制與紀錄，別名不會被送出
title.en: Telemetry gets controls and context, while aliases stay private

body.zh-TW: 你能用新增的 telemetry 指令查看或調整遙測（telemetry，匿名收集的使用紀錄）設定，也不用再靠環境變數才啟用。GitHub CLI 開始以抽樣方式記錄指令使用情況，並特別記錄技能、官方擴充功能、CI 環境（自動執行測試或部署的環境）與 AI 代理呼叫的脈絡；若沒有可送出的遙測資料，也會留下紀錄說明。相反地，你自訂的別名不會被送出。這些資訊用來了解功能如何被使用，不代表記下每次操作。像商店抽樣統計哪些貨架常被看，但不抄下每位客人替商品取的綽號。
body.en: You can use the new telemetry command to inspect or adjust telemetry settings, and it no longer needs an environment variable to be enabled. GitHub CLI now samples command use and records context for skills, official extensions, CI environments that run tests or deployments automatically, and AI-agent invocations. When there is no telemetry to send, it records that fact too. Your custom aliases, however, are not sent. This data helps show how features are used; it is not a ledger of every action. It is like a shop sampling which shelves people view, without copying the nicknames each shopper gives its products.

title.zh-TW: 新增 gh skill：找、裝、看、更新與發布技能
title.en: New gh skill commands let you find, install, preview, update, and publish skills

body.zh-TW: 你現在能用 `gh skill` 把技能（skill，教 AI 或工具完成特定工作的說明包）找出來、預覽、安裝、更新或發布。打錯未知指令時，GitHub CLI 會建議可安裝的官方擴充功能；安裝擴充功能與只在本機使用的技能選項，也不再先要求登入。`api` 與 `auth` 指令也會記錄 AI 代理呼叫。發布前會推送尚未推送的提交，並改用目標資料夾的遠端設定。這次也修好搜尋時誤把不同命名空間的同名技能合併、路徑含特殊字元找不到技能，以及 `gh release list --limit 0` 無限迴圈等問題。像逛工具店：能先看貨、直接帶回家，結帳時店員也會把你手上的清單一併送出。
body.en: You can now use `gh skill` to search for, preview, install, update, and publish skills: instruction packages that teach an AI or tool a particular job. If you enter an unknown command, GitHub CLI can suggest an official extension to install. Installing extensions and local-only skill options no longer require an authentication check. The `api` and `auth` commands also record agentic invocations. Publishing now pushes unpushed commits first and uses the target directory's remote. Search also keeps same-named skills from different namespaces separate, handles encoded parent paths, and `gh release list --limit 0` no longer loops forever. It is like a tool shop where you can inspect an item, take it home, and have the clerk send your pending paperwork with it.

body.zh-TW: 你在驗證下載檔或發布技能時，能看到更完整的安全與操作說明。文件補上 PGP 金鑰指紋、金鑰環檔案的 SHA／MD5 校驗碼、正確的 SHA512 值，以及相依套件 CVE 漏洞處理政策；技能指令與 agent skills 也補齊文件。程式內部則升級 Go、替換壓縮套件、移除過時的 Debian 開發腳本，並替官方擴充功能與技能套件補上建議、審查負責人、共用探索流程和測試。發布測試不再真的呼叫 Git，`--dry-run` 的錯誤訊息也一致，並移除多餘的備援邏輯。像寄掛號信：封條、驗證碼與收件規則都寫清楚，寄件流程也先在練習櫃台跑過。
body.en: You now get clearer security and operating notes when verifying downloads or publishing skills. Documentation adds PGP key fingerprints, SHA/MD5 checksums for keyring files, the corrected SHA512 value, and a dependency CVE policy; it also documents skill commands and agent skills. Internally, the CLI updates Go, replaces a compression package, removes an old Debian development script, and adds recommendations, code reviewers, shared discovery, and tests around official extensions and skill packages. Publish tests no longer invoke real Git, `--dry-run` messages match, and redundant fallback logic is gone. It is like registered mail: the seal, verification code, and delivery rules are explicit, and the route has been rehearsed at a practice counter.

These updates do not add a button for you; they keep the underlying parts on their newer releases. The notes also credit five first-time contributors. It is like servicing a car: belts, filters, and connectors inside the engine are renewed one by one, while the dashboard looks the same and the drive depends on them.

It is like finding a name in your contacts before handing over a letter.

body.zh-TW: 你下載 Windows 版 gh 時，發行端的程式碼簽署已從 client secret（應用程式保存的登入密鑰）改為 OIDC（讓工作流程向身分服務即時換取短期身分證明）；這是發行流程的安全調整，不會改變你的使用指令。同時，上一版整理 project 查詢權限錯誤、以及讓建立 project issue 的範圍錯誤更清楚的兩項修改都被撤回。像門禁改成每次進門領一張短效通行證，但管理員也把兩條剛換、尚不合用的指示牌先換回原樣。
body.en: When you download gh for Windows, the release process now signs code with OIDC instead of a client secret. This changes how the publisher proves its identity during release, not the commands you use. Two changes from the previous release were also reverted: shared handling for project-query scope errors and clearer scope errors while creating project issues. It is like replacing a permanent door key with a short-lived entry pass for each visit, while putting two newly changed signs back until they are ready.

It is like labelling office tasks with names and a link to the original sheet, so the next person does not have to guess who is who or which copy matters.

title.zh-TW: 修正專案資料更新時傳遞查詢變數的方式
title.en: Fix query variables used when changing project data

body.zh-TW: 你在 gh 裡修改 Project（GitHub 上整理工作項目的看板）資料時，這版修正了 mutation query（向伺服器送出「請改資料」指令的查詢）使用變數的方式。變數就像隨表單附上的欄位值；指令本身即使寫對，欄位交給伺服器的方法不對，更新仍可能無法照預期完成。原始紀錄只說明修正了這個變數用法，沒有列出受影響的欄位或錯誤畫面，所以不把它誇大成新功能。它像把已填好的表單改用正確的信封寄出，內容不變，但收件端才能正確處理。
body.en: When you change Project data—a GitHub board for organizing work—through gh, this release fixes how a mutation query uses its variables. A mutation query is a request telling the server to change data, and its variables are the field values attached to that request. Even with the request written correctly, passing those values incorrectly can keep an update from completing as expected. The release note does not name the affected fields or an error screen, so this is a targeted fix rather than a new feature. It is like sending a completed form in the right envelope: the form is unchanged, but the recipient can now process it correctly.

title.zh-TW: 專案項目清單可用查詢條件篩選
title.en: Filter project item lists with a query

body.zh-TW: 整理 GitHub 專案看板時，`gh project item-list` 現在可加上 `--query` 旗標（指令後用來指定做法的選項），用查詢條件挑出想看的項目，不必先把整張清單都撈出來再自己找。這特別適合待辦很多、只想聚焦某類項目的看板。隨後也整理了這項查詢功能加入時的程式碼，讓它維持一致。就像圖書館目錄多了一個搜尋欄，你先寫好條件，再拿到需要的那排書。
body.en: When organizing a GitHub project board, `gh project item-list` can now take a `--query` flag, an option that tells a command how to act. You can use a query to select the items you need instead of retrieving the entire list and searching through it yourself. That helps on boards with many tasks when you only want one kind of item. The accompanying implementation was also cleaned up. It is like adding a search box to a library catalog before you walk to the shelf.

Clean up project item-list query addition changes by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12714

title.zh-TW: 可取得手動觸發工作流程的執行詳情
title.en: Retrieve details for manually dispatched workflow runs

body.zh-TW: 你手動啟動 GitHub Actions 工作流程（workflow，依步驟自動執行工作的設定）後，gh 現在能取得這次手動觸發執行的詳細資料。以前看執行紀錄時，手動按下啟動的那一趟可能少了可追查的資訊；現在工具會把它當成可辨識的一次執行來讀取。這讓你檢查部署、測試或其他自動化工作時，更容易確認剛剛啟動的是哪一次。就像叫了外送後能看到那一張訂單，而不是只知道店家曾經出餐。
body.en: After you manually start a GitHub Actions workflow, gh can now retrieve details for that dispatched run. A workflow is a configured sequence of automated steps. Previously, a run started with the manual button could have less traceable information when you reviewed executions. Now the tool recognizes and retrieves it as a specific run, making it easier to check which deployment, test, or automation job you just started. It is like being able to see your own delivery order instead of only knowing the restaurant sent food at some point.

items.original: feat(workflow run): retrieve workflow dispatch run details by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12695

title.zh-TW: REST API 固定使用指定版本
title.en: Use a pinned REST API version

body.zh-TW: 用 gh 與 GitHub 溝通時，REST API（讓程式透過網址交換資料的介面）現在固定使用 2022-11-28 這個版本。API 若隨服務端預設版本變動，原本可用的指令回應可能在沒有改動你的情況下改變；明確指定版本，工具就知道要依哪一套規則交談。這不是讓你多背一個日期，而是替日常指令減少不預期的差異。就像填表時固定拿同一版表格，不會今天欄位忽然換了位置。
body.en: When gh communicates with GitHub, it now pins the REST API to version 2022-11-28. A REST API is an interface through which programs exchange data over web addresses. If the service's default API version changes, a command response can change even though you changed nothing. Naming one version tells gh which set of rules to use. You do not need to memorize the date; it simply reduces surprise differences in everyday commands, like always receiving the same version of a form.

items.original: Pin REST API version to 2022-11-28 by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12680

title.zh-TW: 查看工作流程日誌時正確回傳失敗狀態
title.en: Workflow log views now preserve failure exit status

body.zh-TW: 檢查工作流程執行結果時，就算你同時要求顯示完整日誌或只顯示失敗日誌，`gh run view` 的 `--exit-status` 旗標（讓指令以成功或失敗結果結束的選項）現在也會照實回傳結果。以前加上 `--log` 或 `--log-failed` 後，這個判斷可能沒有被遵守，讓腳本看錯執行是否失敗。現在你既能讀日誌，也能讓自動化據此停下或繼續。就像警報紀錄可查看，警示燈也仍會亮起。
body.en: When checking a workflow run, `gh run view` now honors its `--exit-status` flag even when you ask for full logs or failed logs. The flag makes a command end with a success or failure result. Previously, combining it with `--log` or `--log-failed` could lose that signal, causing a script to misread whether the run failed. Now you can inspect the logs while automation still knows whether to stop or continue. It is like being able to read an alarm record while the warning light still stays on.

items.original: Respect `--exit-status` with `--log` and `--log-failed` in `run view` by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12679

title.zh-TW: 建立 PR 時分叉只複製預設分支
title.en: PR creation forks only the default branch

body.zh-TW: 用 `gh pr create` 建立提取請求（PR，把你的修改送去請專案合併的申請）而需要分叉（fork，複製別人的專案到自己的帳號）時，gh 現在只會分叉預設分支，不再一口氣複製所有分支。你要送出的改動通常是從預設分支開始，這樣做能把建立 PR 時搬運的範圍縮小到真正需要的部分。原專案的其他分支不會因此被當成這次建立 PR 必須帶走的內容。就像只影印辦事所需的主文件，不把整個檔案櫃都搬回家。
body.en: When `gh pr create` needs to fork a repository while creating a pull request, it now forks only the default branch instead of every branch. A pull request is a request to merge your changes into a project, and a fork is your own copy of someone else's repository. Since your change usually begins from the default branch, this narrows what must be copied for the task. Other branches are not treated as required baggage. It is like photocopying the main document you need rather than carrying home the whole filing cabinet.

items.original: Fork with default branch only during pr create by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12673

title.zh-TW: 編輯 PR 時可搜尋指派人與邀請 Copilot 審查
title.en: Edit PRs with searchable assignees and Copilot review

body.zh-TW: 編輯提取請求（PR，把修改送去請專案合併的申請）時，你現在能在互動式提示裡挑選指派人，並可搜尋後把 Copilot 加為審查者。互動式提示是指令一步步問你要選什麼的畫面，因此不必自己記住每個帳號再手打。這兩處也改善了操作速度與無障礙功能，讓使用輔助工具的人更容易完成選擇。就像填會議邀請時，可在名單中找人、勾選 AI 助手，欄位也更好操作。
body.en: When editing a pull request, you can now choose an assignee in an interactive prompt and search for Copilot to add it as a reviewer. A pull request asks a project to merge your changes, while an interactive prompt asks you for choices step by step, so you do not have to remember and type every account name. Both areas also received performance and accessibility improvements, making the selection easier with assistive tools. It is like filling out a meeting invitation with a searchable attendee list and an AI assistant checkbox.

title.zh-TW: 上傳發布檔與編輯 gist 的說明更清楚
title.en: Clearer guidance for release uploads and gist editing

body.zh-TW: 上傳發布檔時，`gh release upload` 對 `--clobber` 旗標的說明更明白：它會先刪除既有資產，再重新上傳，而不是直接覆蓋得像沒發生過事。`gh gist edit` 也加入使用範例，方便你編輯 gist（用來分享短程式碼或文字片段的 GitHub 貼文）。另外修正一處英文拼字。這些改動不改指令功能，卻把可能誤操作的地方先講清楚。就像搬新檔前先在按鈕旁寫明「會先清空舊櫃」。
body.en: When uploading a release asset, `gh release upload` now explains `--clobber` more clearly: it deletes an existing asset before uploading again. `gh gist edit` also gains usage examples, making it easier to edit a gist, GitHub's short post for sharing code or text snippets. One English typo was corrected as well. These changes do not alter the commands' core behavior, but they make a potentially destructive action easier to understand before you use it. It is like labeling a button to say it empties the old cabinet first.

title.zh-TW: 內部維護更新，讓後續發布與開發更穩定
title.en: Internal maintenance updates support steadier development

body.zh-TW: 這一批也整理了 gh 的內部維護：移除回饋 issue 範本、把 issue 與 PR 分流流程搬到共用工作流程、補上功能偵測註解，並讓升級 Go 的工作流程可手動啟動；程式碼錯誤格式與文件來源也做了修正。底層同時更新 Go、OAuth、文字、終端機、簽章與發布相關依賴套件，另記錄一位新貢獻者。這些不是新增給你下的新指令，而是維持開發、測試與發布鏈條。就像店面不添新菜，先把廚房管線和備料流程整理好。
body.en: This release also tidies gh's internal maintenance: it removes a feedback issue template, moves issue and PR triage to shared workflows, adds feature-detection notes, and lets the Go bump workflow be started manually. Error formatting and source-document checks were fixed, while Go, OAuth, text, terminal, signing, and release-related dependencies were updated; a new contributor was also recorded. These are not new commands for you to type. They maintain the development, testing, and release chain, like improving kitchen plumbing and prep work without adding a new dish to the menu.

title.zh-TW: 用 gh 直接安裝與啟動 Copilot CLI
title.en: Install and launch Copilot CLI directly through gh

body.zh-TW: 現在你想在終端機使用 Copilot CLI（讓你透過文字指令使用 Copilot 的工具）時，可以直接輸入 `gh copilot`；電腦尚未安裝它就會先詢問你是否安裝，裝好後接著啟動。若你已經知道要交代什麼，也能在後面接上參數與旗標，`gh` 會原封不動轉交給 Copilot CLI 執行。這不是讓 Copilot 多了新本事，而是把原本要另外找安裝程式、再切換指令的兩段路接起來，像在車站同一個窗口買票後直接上車。
body.en: You can now get to Copilot CLI from the same terminal workflow you use for GitHub. Run `gh copilot` and gh will offer to install Copilot CLI if it is missing, then launch it. Add arguments or flags after the command and gh passes them through to Copilot CLI unchanged. Copilot has not gained a new capability here; the update simply joins installation and launch into one route instead of making you find a separate installer and switch commands, like buying a ticket and boarding at the same station counter.

title.zh-TW: 可清除特定分支的全部快取，建立重複 PR 會即時擋下
title.en: Clear every cache for a ref and catch duplicate PR targets early

body.zh-TW: 現在你要清理某個 ref（Git 用來指向分支或版本的名稱）留下的快取（把先前結果暫存、下次直接使用的資料）時，`gh cache delete` 可以一次刪掉該 ref 的所有快取，不必逐筆處理。建立 Pull Request（PR，把程式修改送人審核的請求）時，如果 head 與 base ref 相同，`gh pr create` 也會直接報錯；同一個起點與目標沒有可合併的差異，早點停下比建立後才發現更省事。貢獻指南同時改得更清楚，並記錄了兩位首次貢獻者。像整理倉庫時按區清空舊紙箱，門口也先攔住要把同一份文件送給自己的表單。
body.en: You can now clear all cached results attached to one ref—a Git name that points to a branch or version—with a single `gh cache delete` action instead of removing them one by one. `gh pr create` also now errors when its head and base refs are identical, because there is nothing to merge between the same starting point and destination. The contributor guide was clarified, and the release records two first-time contributors. It is like emptying every old box in one warehouse aisle while a guard stops a form addressed from you to you before it reaches the desk.

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽網頁時可直接切到 Actions
title.en: Browse straight to Actions

body.zh-TW: 想從終端機直接看 GitHub Actions（自動執行測試、建置或部署工作的服務），現在 gh browse 多了一個 --actions 旗標（flag，附在指令後改變行為的選項）。它讓瀏覽指令能指定開啟 Actions 頁面，不必先進專案首頁再手動切換分頁。公告只說新增這個旗標，沒有承諾改變工作流程的內容或結果。就像電梯多了一顆直達地下停車場的按鈕：目的地沒變，只是少按幾次樓層鍵。
body.en: When you want to inspect GitHub Actions—the service that runs automated tests, builds, or deployments—from the terminal, gh browse now has an --actions flag. A flag is an option added to a command to change what it opens, and this one sends the browse command to the Actions page instead of making you start on a repository page and switch tabs. The notes only add this shortcut; they do not claim to change what workflows do or produce. Like adding a direct elevator button for the parking garage: same destination, fewer buttons.

body.zh-TW: 你設定 gh repo set-default 的預設專案時，現在可以使用 Git remote（遠端連線名稱，例如 origin）名稱來指定。這讓已經替同一份程式碼設好多個遠端位置的人，可以沿用自己看得懂的名稱來選擇預設目標；公告沒有說會自動替你新增或改寫 remote。就像寄件簿裡已有「公司」和「個人」兩個收件人標籤，現在可直接挑標籤，不必再重抄完整地址。

That helps people who already gave one codebase several remote destinations choose the default by the label they recognize. The notes do not say the command will create or rewrite any remotes for you. It is like choosing an existing “work” or “personal” label in an address book instead of copying the full address again.

title.zh-TW: 專案資料異常不再讓工具直接中斷
title.en: Unexpected project data no longer makes the tool stop abruptly

body.zh-TW: 你處理 GitHub 專案資料時，遇到 null project items（空值的專案項目，代表資料位置存在但沒有可讀內容）不會再觸發 panic（程式無法自行處理錯誤而突然中止）。這是既有處理流程的修復，不是新增專案管理功能。同一版也修正安裝指南裡 Debian CLI 套件連結，讓讀者前往正確位置。就像清單裡有一格空白時，工作人員會跳過那格繼續辦事，而入口指示牌也改成正確方向。
body.en: When working with GitHub project data, null project items—places where an item exists but has no readable value—will no longer trigger a panic, an abrupt program stop when it cannot handle an error. This is a repair to an existing path, not a new project-management feature. The same release also corrected the Debian CLI package link in the installation guide, sending readers to the right place. body.en: You do not need to change any everyday command, but this release updated OAuth, signing, build verification, and several Go dependencies. Extension workflow templates also update actions/checkout. The notes do not claim a new terminal feature, so this is best read as ongoing care for the release factory. Like maintaining a warehouse’s sealers, sorting rules, and spare parts while the kinds of parcels it sends remain the same.

This change specifically isolates a user-provided search query from its background qualifiers; the release notes do not claim any other search behavior changed. It is like giving a librarian one note saying “cookbooks” and another saying “in this branch only,” instead of accidentally making the restriction part of the title.

title.en: Release lists can identify immutable releases

body.zh-TW: 現在你用 `gh release list` 取得 JSON（方便其他程式讀取的固定格式資料）時，會多看到 `isImmutable` 欄位。它會標示這個發行版本是否不可變，也就是發出去後不該再被修改。若你用指令自動檢查版本或串接部署流程，就能先辨認哪些版本要當成定稿處理，少把仍可變動的版本和正式封存版混在一起。這像圖書館替每本書標上「可借閱」或「館藏定本」，一眼就知道哪本不能隨意改頁。
body.en: When you use `gh release list` to get JSON, a structured format other programs can read, you now get an `isImmutable` field. It marks whether a release is immutable, meaning it should not be changed after publication. If you automate release checks or deployment workflows, you can distinguish a final archived release from one that may still change. It is like a library label showing which copy is the unalterable reference edition.

It is like dropping a letter straight into the right specialist mailbox instead of routing it through a central mailroom.

body.zh-TW: 現在你執行 `gh repo delete --yes` 卻沒有指定倉庫時，指令會提醒 `--yes` 被忽略，而不是讓你以為已略過確認。另新增 `gh pr revert`，可替一個 pull request（PR，把程式修改送來審查與合併的提案）建立反轉那次修改的操作。前者讓刪除前的判斷更清楚，後者讓已合併的改動有一條回頭路。這像拆房前先確認地址，裝錯零件後也能照說明把它換回來。
body.en: If you run `gh repo delete --yes` without naming a repository, the command now warns that `--yes` is being ignored instead of making you think confirmation was skipped. A new `gh pr revert` command can also reverse the changes from a pull request, a proposal to review and merge code changes. One makes deletion intent clearer; the other gives merged work a route back. It is like checking the address before demolition and having instructions to undo a wrongly fitted part.

body.en: You can now view and edit larger Gist files, the small GitHub posts used to share code snippets or text files, from the CLI. This repairs existing behavior rather than adding a new file service: reads and edits that failed because a file was large now work again. If you keep a long configuration file, log, or code sample in a Gist, you need not switch tools just because of its size. title.zh-TW: 驗證發行證明遇到 Sigstore 暫時不可用仍可運作

The command also uses `release` as the sentinel value for release-attestation verification. This makes the existing verification path more resilient when an outside service is unavailable; it does not mean skipping verification. It is like having a valid backup inspection desk when the main parcel-seal counter is briefly closed.

It's like changing an order at a branch that has no old service counter: the clerk handles the order directly instead of sending you to look for a counter that is not there.

title.zh-TW: `gh pr edit` 指定審核者，不用每次都先抓一輪組織團隊名單
title.en: `gh pr edit` no longer fetches your org's whole team list just to add a reviewer

body.zh-TW: 你用 `gh pr edit` 幫一份 PR（pull request，你送出等人審核、準備合併的一份程式碼修改）指定審核者，如果只是加某個人，不是加某個團隊，以前這個指令還是會先跑去組織裡把整份團隊名單抓一遍，不管你用不用得到。⟦就像去檔案庫辦事，只有真的要用到某份檔案才去調閱它，不會每次進門都先把整個檔案庫翻一遍。⟧現在 `gh pr edit` 只有你真的要指定某個團隊當審核者時，才會去抓這份名單，其餘情況直接跳過這一步。對你來說，差別在於單純加個人當審核者的操作，不會再被一趟用不到的名單查詢拖慢。
body.en: You use `gh pr edit` to set reviewers on a PR — a pull request, the code change you've submitted and are waiting on someone to review before it merges. Add just one person, not a team, and until now the command would still go fetch your entire org's team list first, whether you needed it or not. ⟦It's like visiting an archive: you only pull a specific record when you actually need it, you don't flip through the whole archive every time you walk in the door.⟧ Now `gh pr edit` only fetches that list when you're actually naming a team as a reviewer, and skips the step the rest of the time. For you, that means adding a single person as a reviewer no longer gets slowed down by a team lookup you never needed.

title.zh-TW: 快取筆數、轉圈指示器、派工倉庫、登入通道，四處小毛病一次修好
title.en: Cache delete counts, the spinner, task-dispatch repo, and login — four small fixes at once

body.zh-TW: 這幾個小毛病都出在不會特別留意的地方。清快取（cache，算過的結果先存著、下次直接拿）時，`gh cache delete` 回報的刪除筆數以前會算錯。不管你只給 key，還是 key 再加上 ref（git 參照，標出這份快取屬於哪個分支），現在數字都對得上。`gh agent-task create` 加 `--follow` 看進度，以前跑完那個轉圈指示器不會自己停，現在結束就跟著收掉。同樣是這個指令，以前派工可能送到上游倉庫（upstream repo，你這份倉庫的來源），而不是你設定的預設倉庫，現在會送對。另外，`auth login` 與 `auth refresh` 改走 UNIX socket（同一台電腦裡程式互傳資料的通道，不繞網路）。⟦像搬完家才發現的幾件小事：箱數少算了、玄關燈忘了關、一封信還寄到舊地址、電話線也沒接上新插孔，這次一併收拾。⟧
body.en: These are the kind of small bugs you'd never notice unless you hit them directly. When you clear the cache — results stored earlier so you don't have to recompute them — `gh cache delete` used to report the wrong number of deleted entries; now the count is right whether you pass just a key or a key plus a ref, the git reference marking which branch a cache entry belongs to. Run `gh agent-task create` with `--follow` to watch progress, and the spinner used to keep spinning after the run finished; now it stops right when the task does. That same command used to sometimes dispatch work to the upstream repo — the repo yours was forked from — instead of your configured default repo; now it goes to the right one. And `auth login` and `auth refresh` now talk over a UNIX socket instead of the network. ⟦It's like the handful of things you only notice after you've finished moving house: you miscounted the boxes, forgot to turn off the hallway light, a letter still went to the old address, and the phone line never got hooked up to the new jack — this round cleans up all four.⟧

title.zh-TW: gh 新增 release verify 指令，確認發行版沒被人動過手腳
title.en: gh adds a release verify command so you can confirm a release hasn't been tampered with

body.zh-TW: 你打包版本發布給同事下載，或反過來下載別人放上去的檔案，想確認沒被偷換——這正是 gh 新增的 `release verify` 與 `release verify-asset` 要處理的事。每個發行版能附上一份 attestation（證明文件，帶簽章與時間戳，把版本、git 標籤與檔案綁在一起）。⟦就像精品出廠附的保證書印著編號跟日期，對得起來才確定是真品，沒被掉包。⟧驗證最新的發行版，打 `gh release verify`；驗證特定版本，加上標籤打 `gh release verify v1.2.3`。手上某個附件檔案，想對到最新發行版，打 `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`；要對到特定版本，標籤也加進去，打 `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`。
body.en: You've packaged a release for coworkers to download, or you're the one downloading something someone else uploaded, and you want to be sure it wasn't swapped for something else — that's what gh's new `release verify` and `release verify-asset` handle. Every release can carry an attestation, a signed, timestamped document that ties the release to its version, its git tag, and its files. ⟦It's like a luxury item's warranty card printed with a serial number and a date — if they match, you know it's the real thing and nothing's been switched.⟧ To verify the latest release, run `gh release verify`; to verify a specific one, add the tag: `gh release verify v1.2.3`. Got an asset file you want to match against the latest release? Run `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`; to match it against a specific release, add the tag too: `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`.

title.zh-TW: gh 新增 agent-task 指令組，在終端機裡派工給程式碼代理
title.en: gh adds an agent-task command group to hand code work to the coding agent from your terminal

body.zh-TW:
剩一段程式碼想整理，你正忙著別的事，於是把它交給 GitHub 的 coding agent（程式碼代理，替你動手改程式的自動助手）——gh 新增的 `agent-task` 指令組，就是在終端機裡派工與追蹤的工具。

```
gh agent-task create "refactor the codebase"   # 派一件工作出去
gh agent-task list                             # 列出你所有任務
gh agent-task view 1234                        # 看某一件的細節
gh agent-task view 1234 --log --follow         # 邊跑邊看
```

最後那個寫法會即時印出執行紀錄（log，程式跑的時候一行一行留下的文字）。同一組指令另外給了三個順手的別名，`gh agent-tasks`、`gh agent`、`gh agents` 打起來都通。⟦一個人有本名，也有幾個熟人喊的小名，喊哪一個，到場的都是同一位。⟧這組指令還在預覽階段，用法可能說改就改，不會事先通知。
body.en:
You've got a chunk of code that needs cleaning up but you're busy with something else, so you hand it to GitHub's coding agent — an automated assistant that edits code for you. gh's new `agent-task` command group is how you dispatch and track that work right from the terminal.

```
gh agent-task create "refactor the codebase"   # send off a task
gh agent-task list                             # list all your tasks
gh agent-task view 1234                        # see details on one
gh agent-task view 1234 --log --follow         # watch it run live
```

That last form streams the log in real time as the task runs. The same command group ships with three handy aliases — `gh agent-tasks`, `gh agent`, and `gh agents` all work the same way. ⟦You go by your given name, but the people who know you well call you by a nickname too — whichever one gets used, it's still you who shows up.⟧ The command group is still in preview, so its behavior can change without notice.
